Hi Alex,

As you may have heard, the Metaverse department is being shut down. We want to help place everyone internally before considering other options.

Good news — based on your profile and skills, we've found a potential match for you. You've been added to the #platform-team-hiring channel, where the hiring team will share next steps.

The match was made because your Senior Backend Engineering experience with Python, FastAPI, and event-driven architecture aligns well with the Platform team's needs.

Please keep an eye on that channel for updates. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to HR.

Wishing you all the best through this transition.
